title: Comparison of upper density with Hausdorff measure (Simon 1, Theorem 3.3)
statement: For all P, n ∈ ℕ, every Borel measure ν on ℝ^P, every open V ⊆ ℝ^P, every set A ⊆ V (not necessarily measurable) and every t ∈ [0, ∞]: if the upper density Θ*ⁿ(ν, x) := limsup_{r↓0} ν(B̄_r(x))/(ω_n rⁿ) (dimensionalUpperDensity ν n univ x) satisfies Θ*ⁿ(ν, x) ≥ t for every x ∈ A, then t·Hⁿ(A) ≤ ν(V), where Hⁿ(A) = μHE[n](A) is the outer n-dimensional Hausdorff measure.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (ν : Measure (Eucl P)) (A V : Set (Eucl P)) (t : ℝ≥0∞), IsOpen V → A ⊆ V → (∀ x ∈ A, t ≤ dimensionalUpperDensity ν.toOuterMeasure (n : ℝ) univ x) → t * (μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P)) A ≤ ν V
